calibration_provenance: isotonic on the selection folds' OOF training-pool predictions iff selected-model OOF ECE > 0.05; never fit on the held-out source

determinism.note: no wall-clock fields in any artifact by design; runtime is printed to stdout only

operationalizations.acceptance_sensitivity_direction: sensitivity preserves direction iff the parent-only macro T-minus-M delta is > 0, matching the positive primary macro delta required by condition (1)
operationalizations.classification: PARTIAL uses the v007 materiality margin: a primary arm materially above chance at ROC-AUC >= 0.55 in >= 2 of 3 cells
operationalizations.coefficient_consistency: majority sign's fold fraction; exactly-zero coefficients count for neither sign
operationalizations.direction_consistency: a fold counts only when both training sources' univariate AUC signs are defined (both classes present, AUC != 0.5) and equal
operationalizations.headline_probability: headline metrics use RAW probabilities; calibration moves Brier/ECE only (isotonic is monotone)
operationalizations.identifiability: per feature, once per pool: unweighted pool scaler, frozen LR spec per GroupKFold(5) fold predicting the source from the single standardized feature; statistic = max over folds of max(AUC_s0, 1 - AUC_s0); gate < 0.85
operationalizations.non_constancy: pool-level per training source (std > 0 required in both)
operationalizations.size_rules: fill to 5 by stability score = direction folds + coefficient folds (ties lexicographic); trim to 20 by min(direction, coefficient) folds (ties lexicographic)

scaler_provenance: StandardScaler fit on the training pool's rows (weighted), applied to all splits of that cell; held-out statistics never enter any fitted quantity

weights_definition.parent_x_source_balanced: parent-balanced x source-balanced: each training source equal total weight; within a source each parent equal (1/(training episodes of that parent), normalized per source); implemented as sample_weight, fit only
